_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: Purchase requisition (aanvraag) capability: an employee raises a Requisition with RequisitionLine items, it is submitted for approval, approved/rejected, and an approved Requisition converts to a PurchaseOrder (member 02 of bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way, unchanged). Approval routing deliberately reuses the existing commitment mandate/budget infrastructure from bookkeeping-verplichtingenadministratie (OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\MandateEnforcer, OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\BudgetBlocker) rather than inventing a parallel approval system: Requisition carries the same `programma` / `boekjaar` / `totaalbedrag_excl_btw` / `soort` field contract those guards already read (schema-agnostic — they operate on the passed object array, not a hardcoded Commitment lookup, whenever the lifecycle engine supplies the object being transitioned), so BudgetBlocker:canCommit runs unmodified against a Requisition exactly as it does against a Commitment. Money fields are integer euro cents (ADR-022).

Requisition.title: Purchase Requisition
Requisition.description: Internal purchase requisition (aanvraag) raised by an employee before a PurchaseOrder exists. Lifecycle draft -> submitted -> approved|rejected -> converted. Approval reuses BudgetBlocker (budget availability + override-mandate) and MandateEnforcer (mandate resolution) from bookkeeping-verplichtingenadministratie via a shared field contract (programma/boekjaar/totaalbedrag_excl_btw/soort) — no parallel approval engine is built. An approved Requisition converts to a PurchaseOrder via RequisitionConversionService, which reuses PurchaseOrderService:createPurchaseOrder unmodified.

requisitionNumber.description: Auto-generated requisition number, unique per administration (format REQ-{year}-{administrationId}-{6-digit-sequence}).
requisitionNumber.title: Requisition Number

requester.description: User ID of the employee raising the requisition. Server-authoritative — always derived from the authenticated session, never trusted from the request body (ADR-005).
requester.title: Requester

programme.description: Cost centre / budget programme code the requisition draws against. Matches Budget.programmaCode and Commitment.programma so BudgetBlocker's budget lookup works unmodified against a Requisition.
programme.title: Cost Centre / Budget Programme

financialYear.description: Fiscal year the requisition's budget impact is checked against. Matches Budget.boekjaar and Commitment.boekjaar (BudgetBlocker field contract).
financialYear.title: Fiscal Year

neededByDate.description: Date the requested goods/services are needed by.
neededByDate.title: Needed By Date

justification.description: Free-text business justification for the requisition.
justification.example: Replacement laptops for the onboarding cohort starting August.
justification.title: Justification

kind.description: Commitment type used to resolve the applicable Mandaat (MandateEnforcer's soort_verplichting match). Matches the soort vocabulary already used by Commitment (e.g. 'inkoop').
kind.title: Commitment Type (Soort)

preferredSupplierId.description: Optional preferred supplier. Required at conversion time — convertToPurchaseOrder refuses to convert a Requisition with no preferred supplier (a PurchaseOrder always needs one).
preferredSupplierId.title: Preferred Supplier

total_amount_excl_vat.description: Estimated total requisition amount in euro cents, excluding VAT (sum of RequisitionLine.lineTotal). Integer cents per ADR-022. Computed server-side by RequisitionService when the requisition is created/updated; read by BudgetBlocker's budget check on approve.
total_amount_excl_vat.title: Estimated Amount (excl. VAT)

convertedPurchaseOrderId.description: FK to the PurchaseOrder materialised by convertToPurchaseOrder, populated only once statusCode reaches 'converted'. Traceability link.
convertedPurchaseOrderId.title: Converted Purchase Order

convertedAt.description: Timestamp the requisition was converted to a purchase order.
convertedAt.title: Converted At

approvedBy.description: User ID of the approver who approved the requisition.
approvedBy.title: Approved By

rejectedBy.description: User ID of the approver who rejected the requisition.
rejectedBy.title: Rejected By

rejectionReason.description: Free-text reason the requisition was rejected. Required by RequisitionService:rejectRequisition.
rejectionReason.title: Rejection Reason

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this requisition belongs to; reads are scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Requisition is editable by the requester; not yet submitted.

submitted.label: Ingediend
submitted.description: Submitted for approval; awaiting a budget/mandate decision.

approved.label: Goedgekeurd
approved.description: Approved — budget available (or override-mandate held). May be converted to a PurchaseOrder.

converted.label: Omgezet naar inkooporder
converted.description: Materialised as a PurchaseOrder (terminal); convertedPurchaseOrderId is populated.

submit.label: Indienen
submit.description: Submit the requisition for approval. Always routed through human approval regardless of mandate sufficiency — unlike Commitment, a Requisition never skips straight to approved.

approve.label: Goedkeuren
approve.description: Approve the requisition. Gated by BudgetBlocker:canCommit (budget availability for programma/boekjaar, or a valid override-mandate) reused unmodified from bookkeeping-verplichtingenadministratie.

reject.label: Afwijzen
reject.description: Reject the requisition; rejectionReason MUST be recorded (enforced by RequisitionService:rejectRequisition).

convertToPO.label: Omzetten naar inkooporder
convertToPO.description: Materialise a PurchaseOrder from the approved requisition via RequisitionConversionService:convertToPurchaseOrder, which reuses PurchaseOrderService:createPurchaseOrder unmodified. Guarded by RequisitionConversionGuard:canConvert (status must be 'approved'); the actual PO creation is imperative (creates a new cross-schema record and writes back its id) and is performed by the service, mirroring how PurchaseOrderService:blockSendUntilApproved itself mutates lifecycleState outside the generic transition engine.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create/update/lifecycle transition of a Requisition (submit/approve/reject/convertToPO) is logged to OR's immutable audit trail, including actor + timestamp.

RequisitionLine.title: Requisition Line
RequisitionLine.description: Line item on a Requisition. Money fields are integer cents per ADR-022; unitPrice is integer cents so quantity * unitPrice -> lineTotal stays exact. glAccountSuggestion is carried forward as the PurchaseOrderLine.glAccount when the parent Requisition converts.

lineNumber.description: 1-based line number within the parent requisition.
lineNumber.title: Line Number

quantity.description: Requested quantity. Three-decimal precision supports per-unit and per-litre measures.
quantity.title: Quantity

unitPrice.description: Estimated unit price in euro cents (integer per ADR-022).
unitPrice.title: Unit Price

lineTotal.description: Computed lineTotal in euro cents: round(quantity x unitPrice). Integer cents.
lineTotal.title: Line Total

glAccountSuggestion.description: Suggested RGS general-ledger account code for this line; carried forward as PurchaseOrderLine.glAccount on conversion.
glAccountSuggestion.title: GL Account Suggestion

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this line belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create/update/delete of a RequisitionLine is logged to OR's immutable audit trail.
